PROJECT_SCOPE: A simple task management application allowing users to create and view tasks.

APPROVED_FEATURES.name: Add Task
APPROVED_FEATURES.purpose: Allow user to create a new task.
APPROVED_FEATURES.expected_behavior: Task is saved to the database and appears in the task list.
APPROVED_FEATURES.error_handling: Display error if title is empty
APPROVED_FEATURES.data_flow: Input -> POST /tasks -> DB INSERT -> Response -> UI Update

APPROVED_FEATURES.name: View Tasks
APPROVED_FEATURES.purpose: Allow user to list all existing tasks.
APPROVED_FEATURES.expected_behavior: Display a list of all saved tasks.
APPROVED_FEATURES.data_flow: Page Load -> GET /tasks -> DB SELECT -> Response -> UI Render

tasks.id: Used as primary key and UI identifier
tasks.title: Used as task content and display label
